# Sample document fixtures

`sample-invoice.pdf` and `sample-contract.pdf` are used by
`python manage.py seed_demo_documents` to populate the demo workspace
with documents the primary demo flow (upload → processing → extraction
→ review → approval → RAG → workflow) can actually be run against.

## Provenance

**Entirely synthetic — generated by this repository's own
`generate_samples.py`, not sourced from any real invoice, contract, or
business document.** Every name, company, amount, and date in them is
fictional (marked as such in the document text itself: "SYNTHETIC DEMO
DATA — NOT A REAL TRANSACTION" / "NOT A REAL CONTRACT"). No third-party
content, no scanned real-world document, no copyrighted material of any
kind. Safe to distribute as part of this portfolio project's source
under its [MIT license](../../../../LICENSE).

## Regenerating

```bash
cd backend/apps/documents/fixtures
python generate_samples.py
```

Deterministic given the same source — edit `INVOICE_LINES`/
`CONTRACT_LINES` in `generate_samples.py` and re-run rather than editing
the PDF bytes directly.
